body.message:
Hi, 

I hope you’re doing well.

This is Manisha from TFA Dubai.

We are looking for an accommodation quotation for a group visiting Dubai in December and would appreciate your best rates.

Our requirements are:

Stay: 31 nights
Month: December
Guests: 10 people
Rooms: 5 Twin Rooms
Meal Plan: Full Board (Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner)
Could you please share:

Your best group rate for a 31-night stay
Full-board pricing
Any group or long-stay discounts
Cancellation policy
Payment terms
We look forward to receiving your quotation.
